caption:
Got an answer full of jargon? 🤯 Tell the AI who you are.

Try: "Explain [topic] like I'm new to it. Use an everyday analogy."
Then follow up: "Now give me one real example."

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #learning #productivity #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: AI explained it. You still don't get it?
scenes.say: AI explained it, but you still do not get it? Tell it your level.

scenes.title: Ask for a beginner version
scenes.user: Explain Wi-Fi like I'm new to tech. Use an everyday analogy.
scenes.reply:
Think of your router as a waiter.
Your devices place orders.
The waiter fetches them from the internet kitchen.
scenes.say: Try this. Explain it like I am new to tech. Use an everyday analogy. Now the answer clicks, because it connects to something you already know.

scenes.title: The magic words
items: Say your level: I'm new to it
scenes.say: Three parts. Say your level. Ask for an analogy. And ask for one real example.
Without your level, you get jargon. With it, you get plain words that fit you.
